set -Eeuo pipefail
echo LEADS_TWO_SESSIONS_READ_ONLY_START
sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,subprocess,json,sys
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
sessions=sorted(vault.glob('*.session'))
assert len(sessions)==2, 'two_existing_sessions_required'
before=[hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest() for p in sessions]
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/telethon_sessions.py','--online'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=170)
print('SESSION_PROBE_EXIT',p.returncode)
try:
 d=json.loads(p.stdout)
except ValueError:
 print('SESSION_PROBE_OUTPUT_UNREADABLE')
 raise SystemExit(3)
print('SESSION_PROBE_STATUS',d.get('status','UNKNOWN'))
print('SESSION_PROBE_MODE',d.get('mode','UNKNOWN'))
print('API_SOURCE',d.get('api_source','UNKNOWN'))
for a in d.get('accounts',[]):
 print('ACCOUNT',a.get('account'),'STATUS',a.get('status'),'CONNECTED',a.get('connected'),'AUTHORIZED',a.get('authorized'),'IDENTITY_VERIFIED',a.get('identity_verified'),'PHONE_MATCHES',a.get('phone_matches'),'ERROR_TYPE',a.get('error_type','NONE'))
after=[hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest() for p in sessions]
assert before==after,'session_file_changed'
print('SESSION_FILES_UNCHANGED',True)
print('TWO_SESSIONS_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE')
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
PY
